candidate.name: David Voyles
candidate.headline: Senior Technical PM, former software engineer · AI agents and live evals

summary.text: Senior technical PM and former senior software engineer. Runs a personal fleet of AI agents with A/B testing of local and cloud models, live evals on every request, and CI replay gating changes. At Microsoft CSE, co-designed streaming data pipelines and ML models with NBA, NASCAR, Johnson & Johnson, and financial partners, then shipped the APIs and pipelines those teams kept.

jobs.title: Agentic Platforms
bullets: Run an agentic workflow of personalized agents with A/B testing of local and cloud models, plus a self-improvement loop (167 skills, 57 commands, live evals); operated, never authored.
Risk management for the running stack: routing and tool-call changes gated by live evals on every request plus CI replay, so it fails closed before a bad change lands.

Authored a portable coding-agent playbook: versioned adapters any git repo can stamp, fail-closed receipted gates, and a machine layer that dispatches isolated agent sessions; personal infrastructure, not a customer product.
Operate a redundant Mac mini network for that agent fleet, Docker containers, and local models: performance testing, cost comparisons, watchdogs, and self-healing scripts.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Center / Xbox
bullets: Orchestrated an internal AI telemetry pipeline across 74 Azure DevOps queries for 14 PM teams, putting hygiene, trends, and alerts into the work-tracking system they already lived in.

Designed Game Reparenting Validate / Execute Reparent APIs so 8 partner systems kept their existing tools through ownership transfers; Saga compensating transactions; 100% data fidelity, zero rollbacks.
Automated publisher onboarding via Event Grid so entitlements showed up in Battle.net without a side process, cutting manual configuration latency by 90%.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Co-designed streaming data pipelines and ML models with NBA, NASCAR, Johnson & Johnson, and financial partners; models and pipelines showed up in the customer's existing workflows, not a side console.
Translated enterprise account workflows into platform capabilities those product teams retained after CSE left.
Delivered as a senior IC with stakeholders in the room, then shipped the APIs and pipelines those teams kept.
